title: ATOM DIVE: Lost in the Invisible
fiction: Virtual exploration at a fictional learning studio in Masdar City; no actual shrinking or real material rescue.
scope: Comparison of ionic and metallic formation and resulting structures

story_sequence.interaction: Choose investigation order; both branches required

story_sequence.function: Retain evidence; visit other world if incomplete

student_actions: Choose electrons delocalized within the sample
metallic_reconstruction.success: Store metallic explanation and evidence; play V03 once; continue to the other investigation or final comparison.

student_actions: Move ONE electron, not a proton, from Na to Cl in a simplified atom model
Verify 11 protons/10 electrons for Na+ and 17 protons/18 electrons for Cl-
Expand into an extended ionic lattice, not isolated NaCl molecules
ionic_reconstruction.success: Store ionic explanation and evidence; do not require a seventh video.

final_comparison.display: Two unlabeled grayscale scientifically rendered models, with randomized left/right placement. Charge signs and an accessible particle description remain available; palette is not evidence.
final_comparison.last_log: Positive metal ion cores with electrons delocalized throughout the structure.
actions: Match both formation sequences to both structures
final_comparison.success: Set final_supported only after comparison evidence is complete; unlock V05.

error_policy: Supportive spoken feedback over current still, optional subtle UI cue, preserve evidence and allow retry. No extra video required. No humiliating failure or punitive countdown.
audio_policy: Use one recorded line at a time. Branch lines play only when their explicit condition is triggered. Never sort the entire directory alphabetically and play it as one story.
video_policy: Six separate MP4s, each <= 5.0 seconds. No looping for longer speech; hold end frame while the recording continues. Use provided END keyframe as a deterministic fallback.
